hypothesis.statement: The 7 Falls Efficacy Scale items in the BDS cohort (n=163) have good internal-consistency reliability (Cronbach's alpha > 0.8); the newly-authored cronbachAlpha reproduces the psych package (psych::alpha raw_alpha) bit-for-bit and pingouin.cronbach_alpha to machine precision.

analysis_plan.dataset: Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS; the 7 Falls Efficacy Scale items (FES_1..FES_7) across the cohort

decision.threshold: descriptive: cronbachAlpha equals psych::alpha raw_alpha bit-for-bit (|diff| = 0) and pingouin.cronbach_alpha to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the scale's alpha exceeds 0.8 (good internal consistency)
